name: GoogleAds Conversions
shortInfo: Move offline conversion data from a user specified data warehouse to the Google Ads platform
about:
Grow your business with Google Ads. Get in front of customers when they're searching for businesses like yours on Google Search and Maps.  
  
Learn more about [Google Ads Conversions.](https://ads.google.com/intl/en_IN/home/?pli=1)
availableSync:
[Store Conversion Upload](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/googleads/syncs/store-conversion-upload.html)

This sync can be used to request and retrieve store conversion upload data from a user specified datawarehouse to the Googles Ads platform.

[Call Conversion Upload](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/googleads/syncs/call-conversion-upload.html)

This sync can be used to request and retrieve call conversion upload data from a user specified datawarehouse to the Googles Ads platform.

[Click Conversion Upload](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/googleads/syncs/click-conversion-upload.html)

This sync can be used to request and retrieve click conversion upload data from a user specified datawarehouse to the Googles Ads platform.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/googleads/index.html) here.
